candidate.answerReason: The large right triangle has angle B equal to 70°. Its bisector gives angle DBC=35°, and the right triangle BDC therefore has angle BDC=55°.

methods.label: Use complementary angles and the bisector
methods.explanation:
First find the angle at \(B\); bisecting it will give an acute angle of the smaller right triangle \(BDC\). The two acute angles of a right triangle add to \(90^\circ\), so in \(ABC\),
\[
\angle ABC=90^\circ-20^\circ=70^\circ.
\]
Since \(BD\) bisects this angle,
\[
\angle DBC=\frac{70^\circ}{2}=35^\circ.
\]
The figure shows that \(D\) lies on \(AC\), so \(\angle BCD=90^\circ\). Applying the complementary-angle relation in triangle \(BDC\) gives
\[
\angle BDC=90^\circ-35^\circ=\boxed{55^\circ}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
